purpose: Samsung SM-X700 confirmation: tier/adapter, full with no tier warning, device record create/reuse/lock

jobs.label: record-create
post: ls -la {REMOTE}/record; for f in {REMOTE}/record/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done

jobs.label: record-reuse
post: ls -la {REMOTE}/record; for f in {REMOTE}/record/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done

jobs.label: record-lock-held
pre: nohup sh -c 'L=$(ls {REMOTE}/record/codebrix-cycles-device-*.txt | head -1).lock; exec 9>>$L; flock -x 9; echo held $(date +%s) > {REMOTE}/lock-holder.txt; sleep 60; echo released $(date +%s) >> {REMOTE}/lock-holder.txt' >/dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
post: ls -la {REMOTE}/record; for f in {REMOTE}/record/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done
